maya: quick flag 1: sampleapp rerank surfaced a strange dim-mix after a retry yesterday
kevin: dim-mix how?
maya: some embeddings 1024, others 1536 in the same batch. local trace shows identical inputs but retry response had different shape and the client merged them
sam: can you paste the merge helper?
maya: minimal culprit (node batcher v0.3):
```
// bad merge: assumes partials are segments
function merge(base, partial) {
  return base.map((b,i)=> partial[i] ? b.concat(partial[i]) : b);
}
```
alex: concat will create 1024+512 = 1536. python helper already throws on dim mismatch, so we have a parity gap
kevin: also observed retry headers changed; first attempt had x-request-group + x-batch-id, retry only had x-batch-id so SmartRouting served a cheaper 512-dim variant for the retry
maya: immediate fixes pushed to sampleapp: replace concat->replace semantics, add dim validation (throw on mismatch), and ensure retries preserve routing headers. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/944
sam: i'll add a unit + parity test that injects a mismatched partial and asserts the client errors instead of producing corrupted vectors
ci-bot: pipeline queued: devex/embedding-batcher-dim-guard -> started
kevin: docs: onboarding note clarifying canonical response keys (`embedding` vs `embeddings`) and recommend preserving idempotency headers (Idempotency-Key / x-batch-id + x-request-group) across retries
alex: changelog: call out "embedding-batcher: stricter merge semantics (breaking)" so downstreams know this may change behavior if they relied on concat
maya: follow-ups: scan SDKs for concat patterns, add lint rule for merge semantics, stage smoke for rerank pages after CI green
kevin: assign sam (tests), maya (hotfix + docs + scan), alex (changelog). ETA EOD tomorrow?
maya: EOD ok. thanks :thumbsup:
